episodes.title: 30 Celebrities Linked to Cults (Some You'd Never Expect)
episodes.description:
139. Fame promised everything. These 30 stars found something else — cults, closed sects, and spiritual control that cost some of them years, millions, or their families.

From child stars raised inside closed religious communities to A-list actors who lost everything before finally getting out, this is the true story of how belief, power, and fame collided in Hollywood — told through 30 names, counting down to the one story you won't see coming.

Featuring real connections to Scientology, NXIVM, the Manson Family, Children of God, and more.

👉 Some of these names will surprise you. Watch until #1.
